page.overview:
Who is Burt the Bashful?

Burt the Bashful, also spelled Bert the Bashful, is a recurring boss in the Yoshi franchise. He started out as a normal Burt, but thanks to Kamek, Burt grows to a massive size in the events of Super Mario World 2: Yoshi's Island.

Burt is a pale yellow creature with an orange nose and stubby feet. His trousers are blue and white, covering him halfway.

Burt the Bashful is the first mid-boss seen in Super Mario World 2: Yoshi's Island and its remake, where he is found in Burt The Bashful's Fort half-way through World 1. At the end of the fort, Yellow Yoshi encounters a Burt which is enlarged by Kamek, turning it into Burt the Bashful. To defeat him, Yoshi must hit him with eggs six times; with each hit, Burt's pants continue to fall off, serving as an indication of his remaining health. Upon defeat, his pants entirely fall off and he turns red, blasts off and eventually implodes.

During the introduction of Yoshi's Island DS, Burt the Bashful makes an appearance alongside Super Mario World 2: Yoshi's Islands castle bosses and Tap-Tap the Red Nose. Additionally, the mid-bosses of World 1, the Big Burt Bros., are based on him.
